items.title: Write the LLM usage ledger execution plan document
items.context: Convert the agreed design into a formal execution document. The document must distinguish provider-reported usage from approximate prompt-size estimates, keep local Non-authority evidence separate from Authority Server receipt-backed proof, and define implementation, validation, and rollout boundaries without arbitrary optimization.
items.userSees: User sees "Created docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md" and the final response says "Execution document created for Lattice LLM usage ledger; no CLI code or Authority proof was claimed."

happy.desc: The execution document exists at docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-llm-usage-ledger-execution-plan.md and contains the agreed implementation plan for a per-story LLM usage ledger.

edge.desc: The document explicitly distinguishes provider-reported true usage, approximate prompt-size estimates, and unavailable provider usage so estimates cannot be mistaken for billing evidence.

adversarial.desc: The document does not claim Authority Server receipt-backed completion, productionDone, receiptVerified, authorityDone, or fullAuthorityDone from local ledger records alone.

auditLog.reason: Start DEV work for the LLM usage ledger execution document.
